name: commitment
title: Commitment
description: The end of a session, and a week later. `CommitmentPicker` asks each person to pick one thing to do this week, from a short list or in their own words, and says when they will be asked about it. `CommitmentCheckIn` is that question, on the follow-up link…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/commitment

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/commitment.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/commitment';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/commitment

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
